tob-10469: Part I-II of Aquinas’s Summa Theologica turns from God to human life, asking what happiness is and how we reach it. Readers meet one of the most systematic minds in history working at full power.
tob-10969: The complete Douay-Rheims Bible gave English-speaking Catholics their own translation of the Scriptures, rendered from the Latin Vulgate by scholars of the English College at Douai. Its Old Testament appeared in 1609–10 and its New Testament in 1582, later polished by Bishop Challoner. For centuries this was the Bible of the English Catholic household.
tob-0169: The Eddas are the well of Norse myth — the songs of Odin, Thor, and Loki, the shaping of the world, and its fiery end at Ragnarök. This volume joins the Elder (poetic) Edda to Snorri Sturluson’s prose retelling. Together they keep the tales that molded Viking belief and still feed today’s fantasy.
jim-davis-pg7369: John Masefield's Jim Davis — smugglers, Devon coasts, and boyish daring — thrilled young readers. The future Poet Laureate's adventure classic. arxiv-2605-08769: When several AI agents tackle a job together, someone must decide who does what and in which order. A team at Sun Yat-Sen University led by Chengdong Xu and Kaiqiang Ke presents EvoMAS, a method that learns those execution-time workflows while the agents are actually running instead of following a fixed script. The paper describes how the learned plans adapt as multi-agent tasks unfold.
arxiv-2605-08869: Which corners of AI are growing fastest, and which are quietly shrinking? arxiv-2605-09069: Hyperbolic equations model waves; when they degenerate inside the domain, standard approximations stumble. The 2026 paper is PDE analysis for difficult wave problems.
arxiv-2605-09169: Prediction bottlenecks — compressing data to predict well — were hoped to reveal causal structure for free. The 2026 paper is a myth-busting study in causal representation learning.
arxiv-2605-09569: Finding a hidden submatrix — a needle of signal in a haystack of noise — has fundamental statistical limits. Parker Knight and Julien Chhor pin down minimax-optimal detection with sharp non-asymptotic rates. The 2026 paper is high-dimensional statistics at its sharpest.
arxiv-2605-09769: Psychological defense mechanisms — denial, projection, rationalization — hide in text, and classifying them is subtle work. plos-pone-0350969: Growing vegetables against the season can lift Cambodian farmers’ incomes — if the gamble pays. This paper studied the impact of off-season vegetable production in Cambodia. plos-pone-0352669: Pyruvate kinase activators — potential drugs for blood disorders — can be found by computer. plos-pone-0354369: Sodium hexachloroplatinate — a platinum compound — depolarizes and kills auditory cells dose- and time-dependently. This paper demonstrated it in HEI-OC1 cells.
